describe.shard.config.ts: build entry: serialisable declaration plus output blobs/custom/platform sections; builds out/<slug>/
describe.README.md: what the shard declares, its custom code and why, budgets, look, open work (its plan rows)
describe.manifest.json: authored discovery metadata; contains no runtime module
describe.ktx2.generated.ts: your KTX2 table, written by `bake-ktx2` once you bake KTX2 art. The one generated file you commit
describe.discovery.generated.ts: temporary generated discovery bridge; never hand-edit or commit it
describe.data/: build-time authoring inputs and erased JSON type contracts; executable build logic belongs in generators/
describe.generators/: build-time source that emits admitted JSON, WASM and named assets; never shipped as runtime TypeScript
describe.assets/: source assets consumed by the build
describe.blender/: the shard's retained Blender build sources and offline rig checks (build-time only; optional)
describe.test/: optional source tests; never copied into the shipped product
describe.look/: authored data, source assets and generated outputs; executable TypeScript belongs in generators/
